premise: Little Fish can't understand why the rubber ring sits on top of the water when pebbles and shells sink; he pushes it down, it pops back up, and Turtle tells him it's full of air.
inspiration: The 'why' questions of the Just So stories, answered truly and in play: the secret is air.
lesson: Asking why is how you find out.
learning: A rubber ring floats because it is full of air.

en-US.title: Why the Ring Floats
en-US.text: {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} The rubber ring was bobbing on the sea, red and white and round. {ring:pulse} {fish:enter} {fish:go to ring} Little Fish swam up underneath it. [curious] How does it sit on top of the water like that? he wondered. Pebbles sink. Shells sink. {fish:face surprised} So he pushed it down with his nose. {ring:wobble} Down it went… and {sfx:bloop} BLOOP! Up it popped again. {ring:hop} [laughs] {fish:face happy} {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to shore} Turtle crawled down to the water's edge to see. [warmly] It's full of air inside, said Turtle. And air always wants to go up, so the ring floats. {fish:face surprised} Like a balloon in the water? said Little Fish. {turtle:face happy} Exactly. {ring:live} The ring turned slowly round, as if it was nodding. {turtle:live} Turtle tucked her head in, and peeked out again, smiling. {fish:live} And Little Fish wiggled his fins and swam round and round the ring, because now he knew its secret. {fish:hearts}

es-ES.title: Por qué flota el flotador
es-ES.text: {ring:enter} {ring:go to sea} El flotador se mecía sobre el mar, rojo, blanco y redondo. {ring:pulse} {fish:enter} {fish:go to ring} Pececito nadó hasta ponerse debajo. [curious] ¿Cómo puede quedarse ahí encima del agua?, se preguntó. Las piedras se hunden. Las conchas se hunden. {fish:face surprised} Así que lo empujó hacia abajo con el hocico. {ring:wobble} Abajo se fue… y {sfx:bloop} ¡BLUP! Volvió a subir. {ring:hop} [laughs] {fish:face happy} {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to shore} Tortuga bajó arrastrándose hasta la orilla para verlo. [warmly] Está lleno de aire, dijo Tortuga. Y el aire siempre quiere subir, por eso el flotador flota. {fish:face surprised} ¿Como un globo en el agua?, dijo Pececito. {turtle:face happy} Exacto. {ring:live} El flotador giró despacito, como si dijera que sí. {turtle:live} Tortuga escondió la cabeza y volvió a asomarla, sonriendo. {fish:live} Y Pececito meneó las aletas y nadó alrededor del flotador una y otra vez, porque ya conocía su secreto. {fish:hearts}
